verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Gitea can restrict organization or repository access by source IP. The documented security features are user permission management, access control lists, SAML SSO and audit logs. These are adjacent identity and permission controls, not network-level IP allowlisting. One community user limits exposure by tunnelling over SSH, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can restrict access to organization code to an IP allowlist
